title: Framework Execution: Multi-Line Command Normalization
problem: Complex multi-line PowerShell pipelines fail with empty pipe element errors. Framework needs consistent command normalization.
evidence: Multi-line commands with newlines + spaces fail
cause: Command normalization removes newlines but preserves problematic spacing, causing syntax errors in piped operations.

recommended_actions.action: Apply aggressive whitespace normalization: replace all newlines+spaces with single space

lesson_learned: Simple whitespace normalization yields consistent results. Framework needs unified command parsing layer to prevent syntax errors in complex pipelines.
